scientific_intent.scientific_task: Count fatigue stress-history rainflow half/full cycles and their ranges and means
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Extract direction-changing extrema, close nested cycles with a serial stack, emit ordered (weight,range,mean) triples
scientific_intent.discretization: 257 finite dyadic histories, 18140 samples, lengths 2..128, including plateaus, constant/monotone histories and known nested full cycles
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Exact 257 counts and 21258 cycle components, plus 33162 sentinel padding values, native CPU and independent dynamic-list oracle; weighted cycle conservation and known cases
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: 257 independent variable-length histories; 256 threads per block, two blocks
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float64 dyadic inputs give exact differences, means, and branch comparisons; Int32 sample offsets/stacks/counts
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Fatigue stress-time-series cycle extraction, explicitly documented by original rainflow source; no material damage/lifetime prediction
scientific_intent.description: Complete source rainflow cycle operator, including ordered half/full-cycle triples and defined unused-capacity sentinels, rather than only the result lengths checked by original CLI. Six hand cases and 251 deterministic nontrivial histories exercise turning points, duplicates and nested cycles.
scientific_intent.provenance: Native source documents ASTM E1049-85-derived rainflow counting; study certifies named operator configurations, not full standards compliance or fatigue life models.
